en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing a rural village and surrounding farmland viewed from a hillside. In the foreground two boys sit on the slope looking over fields with rows of stacked hay or grain sheaves. Below lies a cluster of farmhouses and village buildings with gabled roofs, trees, and a few industrial chimneys. In the distance, a church spire rises from a larger town on a flat plain framed by low hills. A tall tree stands on the right side of the image. At the upper left, printed in red Gothic-style script, is the caption identifying the place.
